title: curl with wolfSSL and renegotiation
body:
Hi, 

I am using curl (with wolf ssl lib) to connect https endpoint, but connection with this https endpoint gets terminated because server initiates the renegotiation and client does not handle renegotiation. To enable the renegotiation feature in wolf ssl, I have compiled wolf ssl with --enable-secure-renegotiation and use that version to compile with curl, but I am still getting same results.

Build steps:

cd  /home/<home>/gitroot/curl/
 ./configure --prefix=/home/<home>/wolfsslinstall --enable-postauth --enable-tls13 --enable-libwebsockets --enable-harden --enable-aesni  --enable-psk --enable-stacklog --enable-sni --enable-alpn --enable-trustedca --enable-truncatedhmac --enable-stunnel --enable-certservice --enable-enckeys --enable-secure-renegotiation --enable-debug
make 
make install

cd /home/<home>/gitroot/curl
./configure   --with-wolfssl=/home/<home>/wolfsslinstall --without-ssl --without-zlib --enable-debug 
 make 
make install


### curl/libcurl version
Both for curl and woflssl I am using master HEAD.

### operating system
Linux krtos 5.3.0-1032-azure #33~18.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Fri Jun 26 15:01:15 UTC 2020 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

$2 = (SecureRenegotiation *) 0x0


Based on above debugging, it looks like curl wolfssl port https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/master/lib/vtls/wolfssl.c, never calls wolfSSL_UseSecureRenegotiation to set the secure_renegotiation to some value. I am seeing that mbedtls and openssl has renegotiation support (even though it is disable by default and you compile the library with that support).
